sections.Profile:
Challenge eight knights and ladies of the Round Table at their own arcade games — pool, darts, air hockey, foosball and more — then face them again as dark knights once Morgan Le Fay bewitches them and steals the Holy Grail. Turner Pinball's second machine has a layout and ruleset by Jon Norris, a large foosball knight super spinner, and a second set of flipper buttons carrying the company's Finesse Feature.
